IdentityA furious front-liner who shrugs off wounds, frightens foes and hits hardest when the fight turns ugly.

Level by Level at a Glance

Class Abilities

1st Level

Rage

  • Effect: Once per encounter, as part of an attack or your movement, enter a rage that lasts until the encounter ends.
  • While raging, gain a flat bonus to melee weapon damage: +2 (1st-9th level), +3 (10th-14th level), +4 (15th+).
  • The rage ends early at the end of your turn if you have neither attacked nor taken damage since your last turn ended, or when you fall unconscious.

Rage Styles

  • Effect: Each time you enter a rage, choose one style. It lasts for that rage.
  • Reckless: Advantage on your first attack roll each round. Until the start of your next turn, attacks against you by a creature you attacked this turn have Advantage (Disadvantage never cancels it). 8th level: only its first attack against you each round has Advantage
  • Brutal: once per round, when you hit a creature no more than one size larger than you, shove it 10ft or knock it Prone, your choice, never both (Fortitude save against your Class Save DC). 8th level: you may use Brutal on two hits each round, choosing shove or Prone for each
  • Terrifying: once per round, when you hit, use Intimidate on that creature as part of the hit. A creature that saves can't be Frightened by your Terrifying again this encounter. 8th level: once per rage, as part of an attack, Intimidate every creature of your choice within 15ft instead (each saves separately; Intimidate's Level limit applies)
  • 8th level: your styles improve, as listed under each one.
  • Some kits replace one style with their own (see Kits).

Intimidate

  • Effect: Uses your action. One creature of equal or lower Level within 15ft makes a Will save (against your Class Save DC) or is Frightened until the end of its next turn.
  • No daily limit

Primeval Instincts

  • Effect: When not wearing medium or heavy armour, have Advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks when failing the check would cost you HP, Exhaustion or your life (see Fatigue & Exhaustion in The Arneyan Codex).
  • Hold your breath twice as long as normal
  • Survive extreme temperatures and weather 1 day longer than normal
  • Advantage on Fortitude saves made to force march
  • Find shelter, food, and water for yourself in any wilderness environment (1d6+2 hours)
  • Start a fire in 1d10 minutes by natural means
  • Determine true north at will
  • Climb typical natural slopes and swim typical rivers without a check, at half speed, in light armour or none
  • Cannot use the shelter, fire, navigation and climbing abilities above while wearing medium or heavy armour

Thick Hide

  • Effect: While wearing no armour or light armour, gain +2 AC (+3 from 10th level). It does not stack with an ancestry's natural armour or Bracers of Defence: use the highest.

2nd Level

Combat Sense

  • Effect: You are hard to catch off guard.
  • Advantage on checks to avoid being surprised
  • Attackers gain no Advantage from flanking against you
  • A creature that is Unseen gains no Advantage against you unless it is Hidden

3rd Level

Iron Sinews

  • Effect: Your weapon attacks count as magic, so they can harm creatures that only magic weapons can hurt.
  • 7th level: your weapon attacks also deal +1 damage, on top of any magic weapon's bonus (a +1 axe hits for +2)
  • 15th level: +2 damage, and your weapon attacks ignore Resistance to slashing, piercing and bludgeoning damage

4th Level

Primeval Will

  • Effect: Once per day, when damage takes you to half your HP or less, you may gain temporary HP equal to twice your Barbarian level until the encounter ends. If that damage would take you to 0 HP or below, the temporary HP apply to it first.

5th Level

Savage Swing

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • No Disadvantage while you are Raging.
  • If both attacks hit one creature no more than one size larger than you, it makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or, on its next turn, it can move or act, not both; standing up from Prone counts as moving.

Cleaving Fury

  • Effect: While raging, once per round when you hit a creature with a melee weapon, the blow carries through: another enemy within your reach takes damage equal to a roll of your weapon's damage dice, with no attack roll. Your Cleave on a kill works as normal on top.
  • 15th level: add your Rage bonus to that damage

6th Level

Force of Nature

  • Effect: While raging, you have Advantage on saves against spells and the magical powers of creatures (breath weapons, gazes and auras). Magic from the primeval world bends around your raw will.
  • 15th level: at all times, not only while raging

7th Level

Savage Stride

  • Effect: While raging, your speed increases by 10ft, difficult terrain doesn't slow you, and your long and high jump distances double.

10th Level

World Ender

  • Effect: Cleaving Fury carries through to every enemy within 10ft of you or within your reach, whichever is greater, not just one.

Renown: Name

  • Effect: Your deeds are known. Title: Warleader, or an epithet the tribes give you. Tribes and warbands of your people host you and your party (food, shelter, a guide) without a Reaction Check. Your first follower, a young warrior, joins you.

13th Level

Feats of Strength

  • Effect: you can lift, break or carry what would take four people: a portcullis, a loaded cart, a fallen tree.

15th Level

  • Strength Bonus: permanent +1 Strength. It can take the score past 20, to 22 at most (see The Mortal Limit in Character Creation).
  • Renown: Holding: you may found a longhouse and camp as your Holding (see Your Holding (15th) in Keeps & Kingdoms).
  • Your Rage bonus becomes +4, and Cleaving Fury, Iron Sinews and Force of Nature improve, as their entries say.

17th Level

Fearsome Name

  • Effect: you have Advantage on checks to intimidate outside a fight, and lesser foes who know your name may parley or flee before one starts (the GM decides who counts as lesser).

20th Level

Primeval Avatar

  • Effect: once per encounter, as you enter a rage, you grow one size for that rage: your reach grows by 5ft, your Rage bonus doubles, and you count as one size larger for Brutal and Savage Swing.

Renown: War-camp

  • Effect: You may found a war-camp (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 2d6 warriors join it, with one 3rd-level Barbarian to lead every 20. While you hold it, once per season you may call the host: where your name and deeds are known, 10 to 100 1st-level Barbarians answer and fight for 30 days for food and water alone (the GM sets how many a land can raise).
  • The host has AC 13 and fights with sword or axe. Failed campaigns shrink it until your name is restored

Kits: Arneyan Warrior Cultures

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Barbarian folder. Drag one onto your character.

Choose one Kit at character creation.

  • Your kit defines the warrior culture that shaped you.
  • Each kit reshapes one of your 1st-level features, as its Reshapes line says, and improves at 9th level.
  • The peoples, orders and places a kit names are examples, not the only ones: a kit suits anyone from a tradition like it.
